content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT BHU Project Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT BHU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate position at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate position at IIT BHU is 12-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a first-class postgraduate degree from a recognized university with at least one year of relevant post-postgraduate experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years, with a relaxation of 5 years for female, SC, ST, and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online by filling out the Google Form provided in the Important Links section before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate position at IIT BHU.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job for a research project.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT BHU located?
faq.answer: IIT BHU is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement date for this recruitment is 23-07-2026.
